messages: Sophia: Quick design review — pushing a small iteration to the Alerting SLO config modal. Focus areas: compact threshold rows, notification channel picker accessibility, and suppression preview copy. Posting figma + screenshots. Jamal: Nice — first pass looks clean. A11y note: disabled threshold label contrast is low (falls under 4.5:1). Can we bump weight or change to a stronger token? Maria: Agree on contrast. Also the density is pretty tight on mobile/touch — need to ensure min tap target of 44px. Are we still meeting that? Ash: We currently have 40px for threshold row touch areas. I'll up those to 44. Also the expand/collapse chevron hit area is tiny; propose a 24px touchable area with visually smaller icon but larger click target. Sophia: Sounds good — I'll update the spec. Quick copy question: current row copy is `Trigger when error rate > 2% for 5m.` Might be verbose. Suggest `When Error rate > 2% for 5 min`. Thoughts? Kevin: Prefer `5 min` for clarity. Also we use Title Case for metric names elsewhere — `Error rate` instead of `error rate` to stay consistent. Jamal: Title case SGTM. Also recommend a small inline tooltip `?` that explains the window: `SLO window — how long condition must hold to trigger`. Maria: For the notification channel picker: keyboard nav should open dropdown with Arrow keys and Space/Enter selects. Screen reader should announce the channel type (e.g., Email, PagerDuty). Need explicit aria roles for listbox and options. Sophia: Proposed aria: `aria-label="Select notification channel"` and announce count like `3 channels available`. Placeholder copy: `Pick channels or type to search`. Ash: Example markup I'll add to spec comments: ```
